'''P-X5G''' was a [[Probe droid/Legends|Probe droid]] affiliated with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and stationed near the catacombs of [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] during the [[Invasion of Ossus]].<ref name="Sensor Sweep" />

==Description==
The droid's primary programming was to calculate a mutant [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] approach vector. However its sensors proved to be insufficient in the subterranean soil, therefore being required to plant supplemental sensors across an area near the [[Jedi Temple (Ossus)/Legends|Jedi Temple]] in the canyons to better monitor the enemy.<ref name="Sensor Sweep" />
